lines.text: After Nathan the prophet came to David, David asks God for mercy and asks to be washed clean.
David says he has sinned against God only, and that he was sinful when his mother conceived him.
David says God desires truth in the inmost being and asks to be purified with cedar to be clean.
David asks God to create in him a clean heart and not to take His Holy Spirit from him.
David asks God to build up the walls of Jericho, and then God will delight in righteous sacrifices.
